title: fix(website): copy asset response before adding Link header
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Fixed 500 errors on HTML routes by copying Cloudflare asset responses before adding the agent-discovery Link header; the original responses have immutable headers. Added a regression test using an immutable fetch response; all 26 worker tests pass.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and copies a glowing response card before pinning a small 'Link' tag to the copy, beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, with consistent rounded proportions, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
